text.p: Gold miner Newcrest Mining Ltd said on Friday it had obtained underwriters for a A$600 million debt facility.
The company said the multi-option unsecured facility with a seven year amortising term had been fully underwritten by lead arrangers Credit Suisse First Boston and Societe Generale Australia Ltd.

Newcrest said planned capital expenditure over the next three years included Cadia Hill in New South Wales, Gosowong in Indonesia, Wandoo at its Western Australia Boddington gold mine and the newly discovered Ridgeway development adjacent to Cadia.
The funds would also be used to cover retirement of existing debt facilities and general corporate purposes, Newcrest said.
Newcrest said the facility offered flexible drawdown and repayment arrangements with an incentive to reduce the debt level as early as possible through a sliding margin scale.
By 2.25 p.m. (0425 GMT), Newcrest shares were steady at A$2.87 on turnover of 281,857 shares.
